title: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Business and Management

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic and advanced concepts of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in business and management.
Apply data science techniques to solve business and management problems.
Evaluate and apply various machine learning techniques including supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, reinforcement learning, and deep learning.
Use Python programming to develop AI applications in business and management.
Analyze and solve problems using AI techniques.
Evaluate and critique AI applications in business and management.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and manage personal responsibilities.
Work effectively in teams to develop AI applications.
Manage and execute projects involving AI applications in business and management.
Conduct research and develop AI models for business and management applications.
